subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu streaming card full-content updates cause severe latency regression on long replies

question: Should Feishu streaming cards stay full-content-only, or should OpenClaw add a guarded opt-in append/delta mode for deployments where full-content updates drain for minutes?
rationale: The fix crosses a documented external API contract and a plugin config surface: source and live comments show the current problem, but only maintainers can decide whether an opt-in mode is acceptable after earlier truncation regressions.

options.title: Approve Guarded Append Mode
options.body: Keep full-content as the default, add a per-account append/delta mode with clear docs, and require live proof that it improves long replies without truncating content.

options.title: Require Full-Content Mitigation
options.body: Reject append mode for now and require a proven full-content batching or adaptive flush strategy before any fix lands.

options.title: Defer To Workaround
options.body: Leave current streaming behavior unchanged and direct affected deployments to disable streaming cards until Feishu CardKit behavior is better understood.

recommendation.title: Approve Guarded Append Mode
recommendation.body: Keep full-content as the default, add a per-account append/delta mode with clear docs, and require live proof that it improves long replies without truncating content.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package metadata names this handle as the community maintainer for the affected plugin, and the decision is Feishu-channel-specific.
